name: io.github.gudlab/ads-mcp
description: MCP server for Google Ads and Meta Ads. Wraps both APIs directly to manage campaigns.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: OAuth client secret from Google Cloud Console

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Developer token from Google Ads API Center

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Google Ads account ID, 10 digits, no dashes

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: MCC account ID, only if the customer account is managed under one

environmentVariables.name: META_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived System User access token with ads_management scope

environmentVariables.name: META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default Meta ad account ID, numeric, no act_ prefix
